title: An older Mac selects local setup
when: Starting local mode on macOS below 26.0 or with an unreadable OS version
need: Refuse before downloading or initializing embedded PostgreSQL, name the detected and required macOS versions, and teach upgrading macOS or connecting to a team server or upyoke.com. Cached binaries must not bypass the refusal.
surface: Local setup refusal and installation requirements
review: Source regression tests cover below, at and above the floor; deployed host evidence is pending release.
